notes: ASCII text

os-mock-1-013.title: Test hard-link and symbolic-link behaviour
os-mock-1-013.instructions: In your home directory, `gas.txt` contains `He` and `Ne`. A hard link named `gas-hard` already points to the same file, and a symbolic link named `data` points to `gas.txt`. Remove `gas.txt`, then run `cat gas-hard` and `cat data`. The first command should still display the contents; the second should report an error.

checks.description: Read the data through the surviving hard link.
Confirm that the symbolic link is broken after its target is removed.

os-mock-1-013.explanation: A hard link continues to refer to the file data after the original name is removed. A symbolic link stores the target path, so it becomes dangling when that target name is removed.
